name: How to Stop Procrastinating (Forever)
instructions: Procrastination is usually about managing an uncomfortable feeling (boredom, anxiety, self-doubt), not laziness -- naming the feeling can loosen its grip.
Shrink the next step until it feels almost too easy to skip ("open the document" instead of "write the report").
Remove friction between you and starting: have the tab, document, or tool already open before you sit down.
Watch today's video for the full framework on breaking the procrastination cycle.
